Features

Wider Picture, Simple Sharing & Control

Teams can see shared content and remote participants together on one wide screen.

5K Ultra-Wide Screen

A 5120 × 2160 VA panel in a 21:9 format shows more content without splitting the picture.

Anti-Glare Finish

Its 25% haze surface and 4000:1 contrast keep the picture readable in bright rooms.

Wireless Sharing

MAXHUB Share lets up to nine devices share content at the same time.

DisplayPort & HDMI 2.1

DisplayPort and HDMI 2.1 inputs accept 5120 × 2160 at 60Hz from a PC.

Motion Sensor

The display powers on when people are detected and powers off when the room is empty.

Built-In Speakers

Two 16W speakers and a 15W speaker provide sound for presentations and calls.

Overview

One Screen for Meetings & Signage

The UW105NA has an internal player with an octa-core processor, 8GB of memory and 64GB of storage running Android 13. Its OPS slot accepts an optional OPS62A or OPS72A module to add a Windows computer.

  • Microsoft Teams Rooms Signature certification applies to the display.
  • Crestron, Q-SYS and Extron systems can control it over RS232 or IP.
  • MAXHUB Pivot handles remote device management from the cloud.
  • A USB-C port with 100W power delivery connects and charges a laptop.
  • Conformal coating protects the internal electronics.
Connectivity

Wide Range of Inputs

The display connects to PCs, media players, network systems and audio equipment through a wide set of ports.

Four Video Inputs

Three HDMI 2.0 ports and one HDMI 2.1 port are included.

USB Connections

Four USB-A 3.0 ports and one USB-A 2.0 port are fitted.

Network & Control

RJ45 in, RJ45 out, RS232 and an IR receiver are provided.

Audio Outputs

SPDIF optical and 3.5mm audio outputs are available.

Removable Wi-Fi Module

The included Wi-Fi 6 module supports 2.4GHz and 5GHz networks.

FAQs

Common Questions on UW Series (UW105NA)

01What resolution does the UW105NA offer?

It has a native resolution of 5120 × 2160 in a 21:9 ultra-wide format.

02Can it run Windows?

Yes, with an optional OPS62A or OPS72A module fitted in the OPS slot.

03Is it suitable for Microsoft Teams Rooms?

The display holds Microsoft Teams Rooms Signature certification.

04How many devices can share at once?

MAXHUB Share allows up to nine devices to share content at the same time.

05Which inputs support full 5K?

HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort accept 5120 × 2160 at 60Hz. The three HDMI 2.0 inputs support up to 3840 × 2160 at 60Hz.

06How many hours a day can it run?

It is rated for 16 hours a day, 7 days a week.

07How large and heavy is the display?

It measures 2511 × 1124 × 97mm and weighs 89.4kg, with a 1000 × 400mm VESA pattern and built-in handles.

08What is included in the box?

The package contains a power cord, a Wi-Fi module, a 2m HDMI cable, a remote control, a wall mount and a 1.8m USB-C cable.
